pages.text: Heat, energy, release, vitality, entropy. Flames, roaring, crackling. Fire spirits are useful when tamed, and dangerous off their leash.

When a fire shrine is overfilled, excess fire spirits will manifest as lava (the same number of fire spirits as a lava bucket has). Likewise, overdrawing will destroy lava for spirits. If there aren't enough spirits for lava or there's nowhere to place it, seven excess spirits will overflow as a fireball shot from a random surface of the shrine that isn't covered.
